title: Report a problem
description: Tell us what is not working or what you noticed.
report_body_placeholder: Describe the screen you were on, what you did, and what happened.
mail_sent: We also notified the maintainer by email.
mail_skipped: No email destination is configured, so we only stored the report.
mail_failed: The report was stored, but the email could not be sent.
report_expected_placeholder: e.g. "It should save and return to the list"
attach_too_many: You can attach up to 5 images.
attach_failed: {failed} of {total} images could not be sent.
thread_description: The conversation for this report. You can reply here.
attach_retry: The report itself was saved. {failed} of {total} images could not be sent. Press again to send just the images to this report (no new report is created).
attach_retry_note: This report is already saved. Pressing again sends only the images. Edits to the body will not be included.
empty_open_action_hint: To report a problem, use "Report a problem" at the top of the screen.
